name: read_requirements
result:
{
  "requirements": [
    {
      "id": "REQ-001",
      "title": "Seller lists item",
      "text": "The system shall allow a seller to list an item with a starting price, an end time, an item currency chosen from CHF, EUR or USD, and an optional reserve price.",
      "type": "functional",
      "priority": "must",
      "acceptanceCriteria": [
        "A seller can submit an item with a starting price, an end time and a currency (CHF, EUR or USD) and it then appears as an open auction.",
        "A listing without a starting price, end time or currency is rejected with an error message.",
        "A listing with a currency other than CHF, EUR or USD is rejected.",
        "A listing submitted without a reserve price is accepted and appears as an open auction.",
        "A listing submitted with a reserve price is accepted subject to the rules in REQ-012."
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "REQ-002",
      "title": "Place bid",
      "text": "The system shall accept a bid on an open auction item only if the bidder is not the item's seller and the bid meets the minimum bid rule, with bids entered and stored in the item currency.",
      "type": "functional",
      "priority": "must",
      "acceptanceCriteria": [
        "A bid on an item whose end time has not passed, from a user other than the seller, is stored in the item currency if it is valid.",
        "A bid on an item whose end time has passed is rejected.",
        "The first bid is accepted only if it is at least the starting price.",
        "Any later bid is accepted only if it is at least 1 unit of the item currency higher than the current highest bid, otherwise it is rejected.",
        "A bid by the item's seller on their own item is rejected."
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "REQ-003",
      "title": "Live bid updates",
      "text": "The system shall push each new bid to all clients currently watching that item without the client reloading the page.",
      "type": "functional",
      "priority": "must",
      "acceptanceCriteria": [
        "When a bid is accepted, every client watching the item shows the new bid without a page reload.",
        "A client watching a different item does not receive that bid.",
        "When a bid or close event arrives, the list of open items refreshes without a page reload.",
        "If loading the live update configuration fails, the page retries and live updates start once it succeeds."
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "REQ-004",
      "title": "Auction close and winner",
      "text": "The system shall close an auction when its (possibly extended) end time is reached, declare the highest bidder the winner if the item has no reserve price or the highest bid meets the reserve, and otherwise mark the item as unsold with no winner, including when it has no bids.",
      "type": "functional",
      "priority": "must",
      "acceptanceCriteria": [
        "At the end time the item no longer accepts bids.",
        "For an item without a reserve price, the bidder with the highest bid at the end time is recorded as the winner and the winning user sees on the item page that they won.",
        "For an item with a reserve price, a highest bid at or above the reserve makes that bidder the winner.",
        "For an item with a reserve price, a highest bid below the reserve makes the item unsold, with no winner recorded or announced.",
        "Watchers of the item see the closed state and the winner, or the unsold state when there is no winner.",
        "An auction that ends with no bids is shown as unsold and has no winner."
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "REQ-005",
      "title": "Prices in bidder currency",
      "text": "The system shall display prices to a bidder in the bidder's chosen display currency (CHF, EUR or USD) in addition to the item currency, converted using exchange rates from the Frankfurter API (api.frankfurter.app), while bids and stored prices stay in the item currency.",
      "type": "functional",
      "priority": "must",
      "acceptanceCriteria": [
        "A bidder who selects CHF, EUR or USD sees item prices and bids converted with a rate obtained from Frankfurter.",
        "Only CHF, EUR and USD are offered as display currencies.",
        "Converted prices are shown with the currency code.",
        "Conversion is for display only: stored bids and bid validation use the item currency."
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "REQ-006",
      "title": "Separate services",
      "text": "The system shall be built as separately deployable services, including at least an API server and a separate live update server.",
      "type": "non-functional",
      "priority": "must",
      "acceptanceCriteria": [
        "The API server and the live update server run as separate processes or deployments.",
        "Either service can be started, stopped and deployed without redeploying the other."
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "REQ-007",
      "title": "Horizontal scalability",
      "text": "The system shall allow the API server and the live update server to be scaled independently by running multiple instances.",
      "type": "non-functional",
      "priority": "should",
      "acceptanceCriteria": [
        "With two or more live update server instances running, a client connected to any instance receives every bid for the item it watches.",
        "Adding an instance requires no code change."
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "REQ-008",
      "title": "Display-name identity",
      "text": "The system shall identify users by a unique display name of 2 to 20 characters, without a password, rejecting a name that is already taken, keeping one server-side user id per name and storing the issued user id in the browser, with any user able to act as both seller and bidder.",
      "type": "functional",
      "priority": "must",
      "acceptanceCriteria": [
        "A user can enter a display name of 2 to 20 characters and use the system without a password.",
        "A display name shorter than 2 or longer than 20 characters is rejected.",
        "A display name already taken is rejected and the user must pick another.",
        "The server assigns and stores one user id per display name and the browser keeps the user id it received, so the user is recognised on later visits.",
        "The same user can list items and place bids on other users' items.",
        "The system has no admin role.",
        "Leading and trailing spaces are removed from a display name before the length and uniqueness checks, so 'Bob ' is the same name as 'Bob'."
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "REQ-009",
      "title": "Late bid extension",
      "text": "The system shall extend an auction's end time by 2 minutes when a valid bid is accepted within the last 2 minutes before the end time.",
      "type": "functional",
      "priority": "must",
      "acceptanceCriteria": [
        "A valid bid placed less than or exactly 2 minutes before the end time moves the end time 2 minutes later.",
        "A valid bid placed more than 2 minutes before the end time does not change the end time.",
        "Watchers see the new end time without reloading."
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "REQ-010",
      "title": "Exchange rate caching and fallback",
      "text": "The system shall cache exchange rates for 1 hour and, when the exchange rate API is unavailable and no valid cached rate exists, show prices only in the item currency.",
      "type": "functional",
      "priority": "must",
      "acceptanceCriteria": [
        "Within 1 hour of a successful fetch, no further request is made to Frankfurter for the same rates.",
        "After the cache is older than 1 hour, the next conversion fetches fresh rates.",
        "When Frankfurter cannot be reached and no valid cached rate exists, prices are shown only in the item currency and bidding still works."
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "REQ-011",
      "title": "Demo scale and live latency",
      "text": "The system shall support up to 200 concurrent watchers per item and a few bids per second, delivering each accepted bid to watchers within 1 second.",
      "type": "non-functional",
      "priority": "should",
      "acceptanceCriteria": [
        "With 200 clients watching one item and a few bids per second, each accepted bid appears on every client within 1 second.",
        "No accepted bid is lost under this load."
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "REQ-012",
      "title": "Reserve price",
      "text": "The system shall let a seller set an optional reserve price when listing an item, reject a reserve below the starting price, and show bidders only whether the reserve is met, never its amount.",
      "type": "functional",
      "priority": "must",
      "acceptanceCriteria": [
        "A listing with a reserve price lower than the starting price is rejected with an error message and no item is created.",
        "A listing with a reserve price equal to or higher than the starting price is accepted.",
        "A listing without a reserve price is accepted and works as before.",
        "When the auction closes with a highest bid below the reserve, the item is unsold and no winner is announced.",
        "When the auction closes with a highest bid at or above the reserve, the highest bidder wins.",
        "Item pages and lists of open items show whether the reserve is met (reserve met / not met) for items that have a reserve.",
        "No item view, item list, API response or live event sent to bidders contains the reserve amount.",
        "Live bid and close events carry the reserve-met state, so watchers see it update without reloading."
      ]
    }
  ],
  "openQuestions": [],
  "assumptions": [
    "Assumed: Is the reserve price entered and stored in the item currency, like the starting price and bids?",
    "Assumed: Should the seller be able to see their own reserve amount after listing (e.g. on their item page)? The ticket says only that bidders never see it.",
    "Assumed: For items without a reserve, should the item page show no reserve indicator at all (assumed), or something like 'no reserve'?"
  ],
  "outOfScope": [
    "Payment processing",
    "Notifications to winners or other users (the winner only sees the result on the item page)",
    "Passwords, accounts with login and an admin role",
    "Scale beyond demo level (more than 200 watchers per item or more than a few bids per second)",
    "Display currencies other than CHF, EUR and USD",
    "Changing or removing a reserve price after the item is listed"
  ]
}

name: read_design
code_model

actors.name: User
actors.description: Person identified by display name; can act as seller and bidder.

useCases.name: Register display name
useCases.description: User picks a unique display name of 2-20 characters and receives a user id kept in the browser.

useCases.name: List item
useCases.description: Seller lists an item with starting price, end time, currency and an optional reserve price (rejected if below the starting price).

useCases.name: Place bid
useCases.description: Bidder places a bid; validated, stored in item currency, end time extended if late, pushed to watchers with the reserve-met state.

useCases.name: Watch item live
useCases.description: Client watches an item and receives bids, new end times, reserve-met state and closing without reloading.

useCases.name: Close auction
useCases.description: At end time the auction closes: the highest bidder wins if there is no reserve or the highest bid meets it, otherwise the item is unsold with no winner (also with no bids); watchers are informed.

useCases.name: View prices in display currency
useCases.description: Bidder sees prices converted to chosen display currency using cached Frankfurter rates, with fallback to item currency only.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: Supported currencies.

classes.name: AuctionStatus
classes.description: Lifecycle state of an item auction.

classes.name: User
classes.description: User identified by unique display name.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: Auction item, prices in item currency. The optional reserve price is internal and never sent to clients. close() makes the highest bidder the winner if there is no reserve or the highest bid meets it, otherwise sets status unsold with no winner (also when there are no bids).

classes.name: Bid
classes.description: Accepted bid stored in item currency.

classes.name: ItemView
classes.description: Item as shown to a client, with optional converted prices. Never contains the reserve amount.

classes.name: PublicItem
classes.description: Item data sent to bidders in API responses and lists. Has the reserve-met state (null when the item has no reserve) and never the reserve amount.

classes.name: UserController
classes.description: HTTP routes for users: POST /users.

classes.name: ItemController
classes.description: HTTP routes for items: POST /items, GET /items, GET /items/:id. Responses use PublicItem and never contain the reserve amount.

classes.name: BidController
classes.description: HTTP route POST /items/:id/bids.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: Validates display names and issues one user id per name.

classes.name: ItemService
classes.description: Creates and reads items, closes due auctions. Rejects a listing without starting price, end time or currency, with a currency outside CHF/EUR/USD, or with a reserve below the starting price (no item is created). Converts items to PublicItem without the reserve amount.

classes.name: BidService
classes.description: Validates and stores bids, extends end time, publishes events (carrying the reserve-met state) to the event feed.

classes.name: AuctionCloser
classes.description: Periodic job that closes auctions whose end time was reached. intervalMs must be a positive integer; the constructor throws otherwise.

classes.name: ExchangeRateService
classes.description: Converts prices for display using rates cached 1 hour; returns null when unavailable.

classes.name: FrankfurterClient
classes.description: The only caller of the Frankfurter API: fetches rates over HTTPS from api.frankfurter.app.

classes.name: UserStore
classes.description: Persistence of users with unique display name, in the API server's SQLite database.

classes.name: ItemStore
classes.description: Persistence of items (including the optional reserve price) and bids, in the API server's SQLite database. Dates are stored as ISO 8601 TEXT columns.

classes.name: AuctionEventPublisher
classes.description: Publishes auction closed events (closed or unsold state, winner if any, reserve-met state, never the reserve amount) to the internal ws event feed.

classes.name: BidEventPublisher
classes.description: Publishes accepted bid events (with the reserve-met state, never the reserve amount) to the internal ws event feed.

classes.name: EventFeedClient
classes.description: Client of the API server's internal ws event feed. Each live server instance opens the ws (URL read from the environment in its own code), so every instance receives every event; handles incoming events and hands them to the gateway.

classes.name: LiveGateway
classes.description: WebSocket gateway for browsers; holds the open browser sockets by client id and the watchers per item, and sends each broadcast only to the sockets watching that item.

classes.name: EventFeed
classes.description: Internal ws endpoint on the API server. Holds the sockets of the connected live server instances; the API server entry adds each socket on upgrade of the internal path (the live server opens the ws). Every published event is sent to all held sockets.

text:
I added `timeLeftMs(now: Date): number` to `Item` (DSN-015), placed after `minimumBid` to match the order in `Item.ts`. The save and the coverage report both went through.

I left the `Item` description, relations, REQ links and sequences SEQ-003 and SEQ-005 as they were, because no designed flow calls the method. The design has no per-method description field. Your plan also asks to keep the `Item` description unchanged, so the "never below 0" wording is not recorded anywhere in the design.

Three acceptance criteria still show as uncovered. They are not caused by this ticket, and I changed nothing for them:
- **REQ-003 AC4:** the page retries loading the live update configuration. This is browser behaviour behind the `/api/config` route, which the design doesn't model.
- **REQ-005 AC2:** only CHF, EUR and USD are offered as display currencies. This is mostly a UI matter.
- **REQ-008 AC6:** the system has no admin role. That holds simply because the design has no admin actor.

Step P5 (run `detect_drift` and rerun the test suite) is still to do; I haven't run either.
